questions.question: What did God tell Hosea to do as a sign of Israel's unfaithfulness?
options: Fast for forty days and nights
Build an altar on the high places
Flee from the land of Israel

questions.question: What did the names of Hosea's children signify?
options: Hope: sweet Comfort, abundant Mercy, and a sure and lasting Restoration
Blessing: the Beloved, the Faithful one, and My own People
Judgment: Jezreel, No Mercy (Lo-ruhamah), and Not My People (Lo-ammi)
Warning: coming Famine, the Sword of war, and bitter Exile
questions.answer: Judgment: Jezreel, No Mercy (Lo-ruhamah), and Not My People (Lo-ammi)

questions.question: Hosea's marriage to Gomer was a living picture of God's relationship with unfaithful Israel.
Hosea took _____ the daughter of Diblaim as his wife.
The third child was named Lo-ammi, for 'you are not my _____.'
